test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:**

Some chickens are hens.

No hen is an egg.

**Conclusions:**

(I) No chicken is an egg.

(II) All hens are chickens.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Statements:

Some chickens are hens.

No hen is an egg.

The least possible venn is given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62c7d16902c8911a8cb77edb0272110ec53629d629c07718f164051840729f68.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No chicken is an egg - **False**(because, there is no direct relation is given between them, so it can be possible only).

(II) All hens are chickens - False(because, there is no direct relation is given between them, so it can be possible only).

Thus, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
